title: De l'estate au marché impérial
purpose: Open the conversion question from the estate to imperial demand without closing tax/sugar mechanisms prematurely.

zoom_excursion.mechanism: estate conversion interacts with metropolitan demand and trade institutions
zoom_excursion.local_payoff: Tea selection cannot be inferred from hill-country agronomy alone.

content.takeaway: Le débouché impérial fait partie de l'option thé, mais son poids relatif face au capital et au travail reste à mesurer.
